title: Marcos Jr. inspects PICC, Coconut Palace ahead of ASEAN Summit
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. conducted a walkthrough on Friday of two of the main venues for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit and Related Summits next month.
